_note: One release note per plugin version, posted to the Office-Anything release forum by scripts/release-post.mjs (ops verb 发版本日志, product office-anything). Sections: new, fixed, improved, todo; each item one English sentence, at most 160 characters, no PR numbers, ids or hashes. tests/releases.test.mjs requires the current version to have one.

new: The lead keeps a persistent task list: tasks are added, updated, verified with evidence or dropped with a reason, and survive any context summary.
Every lead session start, resume or compaction prints its open tasks, and health turns red for a task left without an update for a day.
One queue for the whole office: list tasks by assignee, overdue or owner, and each desk sees only the tasks assigned to it at start.
A daily digest of the queue is written each morning, and an assignee quiet for a day gets one nudge line in the lead's alerts.
The board has a read-only Tasks panel: tasks by assignee with state, age, due date, overdue marks, the owner's words and the recorded evidence.
A desk can read a PDF the owner uploaded, read-only, the same way it reads an uploaded image.
Health flags any session name the office owns that two live sessions carry, and names which one to keep and which to close.
fixed: When two sessions run one case, the case sweep keeps the most recently active one and stops the other by its own process, never by name.
A case session parked in its doorbell now counts as idle, so it can be closed when idle like any other.

new: Standing desks can close themselves when idle and wake again when work names them, set per desk in office.json closeWhenIdle.
fixed: A terminal tab whose Claude had exited no longer counts as a running desk, so starting that desk opens it again instead of doing nothing.
A desk taken off the close-when-idle list while it was closed is now woken on the next heal instead of staying closed.
A case session that is already busy when it registers counts as up, so its claim is kept instead of being released mid-draft.
Turning on a per-case desk now says its cases open on the next sweep, not to start it by hand.

new: The lead has its own doorbell: one line per new alert, matching log line or open item, de-duplicated, rate-limited and safe across restarts.
fixed: Monitor commands are now judged by the wall: a session's own doorbell runs, anything else is judged as the shell command it is.
The lead's doorbell refuses log patterns that could hang, tests only the first 2,000 characters of a line, and follows only real log files.

new: The lead can chain its listed commands with &&, ; and |, as long as every part is itself a listed command.
fixed: A case reopened after it was closed no longer carries its old close reason.

new: An office can open its lead's wall fully; every lead action is then written to an audit log with credentials redacted, and desks keep their walls.
improved: A floor of secret files no office can unlist, and the lead's chained commands are judged exactly as the shell will read them.

fixed: The lead's audit log also redacts quoted passwords and tokens and database-style password flags.

new: Renaming a desk is one edit: change its name in desk.json, and it restarts under the new name once it is idle, keeping its own conversation.
improved: A message to a desk's old name is refused with its new name, and a desk name that clashes with another desk is refused at hire.

new: Departments: one office with a lead per department and its own desks, and each machine says which departments it runs.
A desk of a department this machine does not run is left alone here: not started, watched, swept, shown on the board or messaged.
improved: Each department lead is started and healed on its own budget, and only on the machines that run its department.

fixed: Choosing this machine's departments now works before office.json declares them, so a machine can be set up first.

new: Idle compact: a desk or lead idle at its prompt with a large context is compacted before its next request, never mid-turn or into a question.
Health lists every office session with a large context, largest first.
A generated Compact Instructions section tells compaction what each desk and the lead must keep, and a check names the sessions still missing it.
After a compaction, a session is told what is open right now, from the office's own read-only command.
A session stopped by the Claude usage limit is resumed once the limit lifts: at the reset, or as soon as another session of the account answers again.
The lead is told once who is stuck, until when, how many messages are queued and what it was doing; after two failed resumes it needs a person.
improved: A limit on one model switches a desk to the fallback model until the reset, then back.

fixed: Another tool's data under the departments key no longer switches departments on, which had left the machine with no lead to restart.

new: A department's desks can live in its own folder; the walls, the send gate, health, the checks, the board and start all follow the desk there.
improved: A moved desk resumes its own conversation, and a desk found in two folders is flagged until one copy is removed.
Departments gain labels and session groups for the token page, and builders are listed separately from the leads.

new: Open a session as a role: office aics, office erp or office construction starts it with its own folder, name and settings.
Inside any session, /role opens another role in a new Orca tab, or brings it forward if it is already open.
improved: Each role's settings are generated from office.json and never stored in the repo, and two sessions never run under one name.

new: Each department lead's doorbell hears its own department's alerts and the office's, never another department's.
Health counts the desks that are up per department, and the board labels each desk with its department.
fixed: Installing the office command no longer needs a writable system folder: it falls back to your own bin folder and prints the PATH line.

new: Every release now posts its own note to the Office-Anything release forum, and health warns while the version you run has none.
A role opened below the office root, such as a department lead, keeps every root hook and permission, pinned to the root.
Boot text can say {up} for the path to the office root and {lead} for the session's own lead, so it stays right after a move.
fixed: A desk left behind as a link after a move counts once, as the desk in its department's folder.
A lead in a department folder can run its listed commands by their relative path, judged by what they really run.
The lead's listed commands are judged from the real folder a session stands in, so a path through a moved desk's link cannot pass as another.
Opening a department lead's role finds that lead running under any of its names, such as lead, and brings it forward instead of opening a second.
A lead or desk with a doorbell is started with a first message that arms it, so a session the watchdog restarts is never left deaf.
A lead found with its doorbell off has the same line typed into its own tab, at most every half hour and only at an empty prompt.
A desk can no longer build the shape of an office inside its own folder, so no office hook can be pointed at a file the desk wrote.
A lead's doorbell rings only its own department's log files and asks: buyer alerts reach customer service, never another department's lead.
A running lead can use a newer installed plugin version's doorbell and commands, so an update no longer strands it on the old one.
A lead launched with Remote Control now receives its doorbell kickoff instead of losing it to the flag, and start says so only when it ran.

new: Scheduled jobs belong to the office, not a session: at their time the watchdog hands each to its role, opening that role if nobody is running it.
A job whose window passes is marked missed, the lead is told, and health says so until someone looks.

fixed: After a plugin update, a lead still running the old version's doorbell counts as armed, so the watchdog stops typing it a kickoff its wall refuses.
improved: Health says when a lead's doorbell runs an older version's bell, so it can be restarted when idle.

fixed: A desk can no longer create an office/ folder inside its own folder, where an office now keeps its hooks.
A desk can no longer build an office folder in its own folder by a bare name, such as mkdir office or mv hooks office.
improved: Health turns red when a desk's folder holds an office folder or office.json, however it got there.
